name: Making Our Move

angles.text: The assault targets the Al'Aketh leadership at the Shrine of Akir, including the hostile High Priestess and her Spiritcallers.

faq.answer: The strike force aims to breach the Shrine of Akir and reach the High Priestess. Fighters charge the front to draw the defenders while the main team flanks their position.
faq.q: What is the objective of the assault in Making Our Move?

faq.answer: Hyusaa Quickbreeze is the strike force's second-in-command. After you thin the Al'Aketh defenders at the shrine, you are to meet Quickbreeze near its steps.
The High Priestess commands the Al'Aketh within the Shrine of Akir. The strike force flanks the enemy lines to reach and defeat her.
faq.q: Who is the High Priestess targeted in the attack?

faq.answer: The Shrine of Akir is a fortified religious site held by the Al'Aketh. Guardians, Spiritcallers and Blademasters defend its central sanctuary, where their leadership resides.
faq.q: What is the Shrine of Akir?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are the hostile defenders of the Shrine of Akir. Their ranks include frontline Guardians, spellcasting Spiritcallers and agile Blademasters who guard the way to their High Priestess.
faq.q: Who are the Al'Aketh forces holding the shrine?

faq.answer: A handful of seasoned fighters enters through the shrine's front entrance to draw the defenders and cause chaos. This gives the main force a chance to flank the compound and push toward the inner shrine.
faq.q: Why is a frontal distraction used in the assault?

sections.body: At the Shrine of Akir, the assault depends on timing and divided forces. A small band of elite fighters charges the front gates to raise the alarm and draw out the defenders. Meanwhile, the commander leads the main strike team in from the flank. Their push divides the defenders' attention and opens a path toward the shrine's leadership.
sections.title: A Coordinated Pincer

sections.body: The Al'Aketh defend the Shrine of Akir with armored Guardians, mystical Spiritcallers and martial Blademasters. The strike force must break through their front lines to reach the inner sanctum, where the High Priestess directs her followers. Once the outer defenders are beaten, you meet the force's second-in-command, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, at the shrine steps.
sections.title: Breaking the Al'Aketh Lines

summary: At the Shrine of Akir, a strike force moves against the Al'Aketh and their High Priestess. A frontal charge will draw the defenders while the main force approaches from the flank.
attribution: In-game quest text: Making Our Move
